thread:
incident-bot: [P1] GPU capacity alert for gpool-east-2 — sustained 95% GPU utilization and request queue > 1200 for model-serving cluster. auto-scaler reported failed scale attempts (limit=8). paging oncall.

maria (oncall): I'm on it. brief: what changed in the last hour? any rollout?

li (eng-sre): yes, there was a late-night rollout at 23:12 UTC pushing model v12.3 to 40% of traffic for the conversational endpoint. metrics: token throughput up ~2.6x, kv-cache size per session increased ~3x. link: https://grafana.internal/gpool/gpu-util?panel=kvcache (^)

jake (eng-runtime): summary from runtime logs: v12.3 introduced wider context retention for heuristics -> kv cache touch frequency up. we're seeing large KV cache pages pinned; eviction not keeping up because of new warmup behavior. also noticed increased average seq_len per request.

sophia (customer-success): we're getting a support case from AcmeCorp complaining about higher latencies and some 503s on their nightly ingest job. they hit a backlog and retries.

maria (oncall): impact: latency spikes (p95 > 4.2s), 5xx rate up to 1.8% on that route. customer-visible for several enterprise customers on dedicated pools? confirm.

alexa (infra): confirmed: two dedicated pools in east-2 are at soft limit. autoscaler failed to start new nodes because we've hit per-account GPU cap and regional quota. cloud provider report shows delayed provisioning.

jake (eng-runtime): mitigation options: 1) roll back v12.3 rollout -> immediate traffic shift to v12.2; 2) enable temporary per-customer rate limits for heavy customers; 3) emergency increase of GPU quota with vendor (slow). prefer rollback + throttle.

nate (product): +1 rollback. throttle as fallback. we must communicate to customers ASAP.

maria (oncall): executing rollback. @deploy-bot, rollback flag to v12.2 for conversation endpoint, gradual switch to 0% v12.3.

deploy-bot: received rollback request. starting canary rollback: routing-service API called.

ops-helper-bot: note: when rollback completes, we should run a warmup disable patch to prevent kv-cache spikes on re-add.

li (eng-sre): while rollback is in flight, apply temporary per-route token throttle to reduce new long-context sessions. command:

```
curl -X POST https://internal-api/route-control/throttle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","max_tokens_per_min":50000}'
```

maria (oncall): throttle applied. reducing traffic to the route by ~30% observed. queue length falling.

deploy-bot: rollback to v12.2 completed at 1769901980. traffic shifted back to v12.2.

jake (eng-runtime): good. we're seeing KV evictions catch up, queue drops to ~200. p95 latency returning to baseline.

alexa (infra): autoscaler still showing failed attempts until quota is increased; but with rollback we shouldn't need extra nodes. keeping an eye.

sophia (customer-success): sent an incident note to impacted customers (AcmeCorp, BetaFin) — apologizing and saying we're mitigating; offered to extend SLAs for the day.

maria (oncall): quick root-cause hypothesis: v12.3's context retention change + larger kv-cache per session caused sudden memory pressure, preventing evictions and triggering throttle/queue growth; autoscaler hit quota so couldn't add capacity.

jake (eng-runtime): temporary runtime patch we've applied: reduced kv_cache_retention_window to 50% for newly routed sessions until we validate. config snippet deployed:

```
kv_cache_retention_window: 0.5  # was 1.0 in v12.3
kv_eviction_threshold: 0.78
```

li (eng-sre): follow-up actions we need before re-rollout:
- add canary traffic at 1% for 30m with kv-cache warmup disabled
- telemetry guard: block rollout if queue > 400 or autoscaler reports fail_count > 0
- add synthetic load test for increased seq_len patterns

nate (product): add to launch checklist: explicit quota check and gated vendor quota request if predicted capacity > 75% for the region.

maria (oncall): handoff to eng-sre for postmortem and long-term fixes. li, jake you own the immediate post-incident. I'll file the incident ticket and notify paging rotation.

li (eng-sre): acknowledged. creating incident ticket: INC-2026-0543. capturing timeline and metrics.

jake (eng-runtime): will open a PR to add rollout-safety checks and change default kv retention back to conservative for canary releases.

sophia (customer-success): will follow up with customers tomorrow; folks please add a short blurb describing mitigation and ETA for permanent fix.

maria (oncall): final status: service recovered after rollback + throttle. customer impact: elevated latencies and limited 5xx for ~18 minutes, one customer reported automated retries causing downstream backlog (AcmeCorp). mitigation: rollback, throttle, temp runtime patch. Next steps: postmortem, rollout policy changes, quota automation.

incident-bot: incident resolved by OP at 1769904821. resolution code: rollback+throttle.

nate (product): note for postmortem: consider adding a pre-rollout lab test for kv-cache footprint and a forced warmup-disabled canary toggle.

li (eng-sre): assigning action items in ticket. ETA for fixes: 48-72h for rollout gating and telemetry, 1 week for automation of quota checks.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. closing thread but keep ticket open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
